g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index alternatives sample shared continuous contours near2mm pitch with1.2mm design circles. Retain one dot at close junctions by omitting candidate centres within1.5mm of an existing one. Scissors loop and pivot contours take precedence; stem and blade samples hidden by the pivot or loop apertures are omitted. These are medium-specific native-dot alternatives inside the shared master, not exact continuous-stroke replicas or guaranteed physical embossing positions.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse the exact continuous object geometry from the swell layer. Ruler and comb bodies receive lower grey surfaces bounded by higher black contours; ruler graduations stay higher. Scissors blade faces and pivot face are lower grey with higher borders; finger-loop apertures remain white unraised, and stems/loop contours remain higher. Height marks structural surfaces and boundaries, never natural colour or unmeasured3D depth.
